data.title: NEW JAMA NETWORK OPEN STUDY SHOWS GIVING LESS IV FLUIDS DURING SURGERY CAN BE BENEFICIAL FOR PATIENTS
data.description: In a recent study published in JAMA Network Open, anesthesiologists at Montefiore Einstein conducted a large-scale natural experiment in response to a nationwide shortage of IV fluids. The study, based in The Bronx, N.Y., yielded significant findings, highlighting the impact of reducing IV fluid usage during the shortage. This research is crucial as it provides valuable insights into managing IV fluid shortages efficiently and ensuring patient care quality during such circumstances.

data.title: Data Center World Power 2026 Showcases Energy Infrastructure Solutions to Meet Growing Power Demands
data.description: In Dallas, Data Center World Power 2026 conference is scheduled to take place from September 21 to 23 at the Gaylord Texan Resort & Convention Center. The event aims to address the urgent issue facing the data center industry: the escalating need for stable power supply. With the expanding demand driven by technologies like AI and high-power workloads, the sector is under immense pressure. The conference will bring together key figures, including industry experts, operators, energy providers, and tech innovators, to discuss solutions. This gathering is crucial as data center growth has reached unprecedented levels, amplifying the necessity for reliable power sources.

data.title: Powerhouse Appoints Sue McCarty as Chief Revenue Officer and Justin Figley as Chief Operating Officer
data.description: Powerhouse, a prominent company specializing in multi-site rollout, refresh, staffing, and merchandising solutions based in Crowley, Texas, recently disclosed significant leadership changes. Sue McCarty has been appointed as the Chief Revenue Officer, while Justin Figley has assumed the role of Chief Operating Officer. These promotions highlight the exceptional performance and dedication of both individuals, whose professional journeys have largely been dedicated to Powerhouse's operations division. According to Michael Wroughton, the Chief Executive Officer at Powerhouse, "Sue and Justin have significantly contributed to advancing Powerhouse's growth and success from within."

data.title: Buywander, Auction Marketplace for Returned Goods, Raises $21M in Series A Funding
data.description: Seattle-based company Buywander, known for its auction-based marketplace specializing in returned and overstocked retail inventory, has recently disclosed the successful completion of a $21 million Series A funding round. This recent funding injection has propelled the total lifetime funding of the company to $28 million. The funding round was spearheaded by Madrona Venture Group and Inspired Capital, with continued support from previous investors including Triple Impact Capital, Silence Ventures, Data Tech Fund, and Animal Capital, among others, as well as contributions from a cohort of angel investors. The acknowledgment of billions of dollars' worth of returned and surplus inventory held by retailers underscores the significance of Buywander's platform in addressing this notable industry challenge.
